proposals.title: Proposal 5 – Shareholder Proposal Seeking Various Disclosures Respecting Environmental and Human Rights Due Diligence
proposals.proponent: Thomas P. DiNapoli, the Comptroller of the State of New York, as trustee of the New York State Common Retirement Fund
proposals.topic_summary: Requests a report describing the due diligence process used to identify and address environmental and social risks, including Indigenous rights risk, in reviewing potential acquisitions.
proposals.evidence: OUR BOARD OF DIRECTORS RECOMMENDS YOU VOTE AGAINST THIS SHAREHOLDER PROPOSAL SEEKING VARIOUS DISCLOSURES RESPECTING ENVIRONMENTAL AND HUMAN RIGHTS DUE DILIGENCE.

proposals.title: Proposal No. 6 – Shareholder Proposal Seeking the Disclosure of Our Strategy to Align Our Business Plan with the 2-Degree Goal of the Paris Agreement
proposals.topic_summary: Requests a report by December 30, 2017 on the company's strategy for aligning its business plan with the well below 2 degree Celsius goal of the Paris Agreement.
proposals.evidence: OUR BOARD OF DIRECTORS RECOMMENDS YOU VOTE AGAINST THIS SHAREHOLDER PROPOSAL SEEKING THE DISCLOSURE OF OUR STRATEGY TO ALIGN OUR BUSINESS PLAN WITH THE 2-DEGREE GOAL OF THE PARIS AGREEMENT.

proposals.title: Proposal No. 7 – Shareholder Proposal Seeking Simple Majority Vote Provisions
proposals.topic_summary: Requests elimination of supermajority voting requirements in the charter and bylaws, replaced by a majority of votes cast or simple majority standard.
proposals.evidence: OUR BOARD OF DIRECTORS RECOMMENDS YOU VOTE AGAINST THIS SHAREHOLDER PROPOSAL SEEKING TO ELIMINATE LIMITED SUPERMAJORITY VOTING REQUIREMENTS FROM OUR CORPORATE GOVERNANCE DOCUMENTS.
